item.title: Digital Audio & Dolby support : Gamecube and Wii
item.description: Since the PC Engine CDROM, developers have experimented with Dolby Surrond support in their games. Prior to that, it was usually not possible to do that as the consoles either lacked Stereo support for the PCM channels or were too primitive (Genesis).
